data.fund_type: An open ended scheme investing in equity, arbitrage and debt
data.investment_objective: The Scheme intends to generate long-term capital appreciation by investing a portion of the Scheme’s assets in equity andequity related instruments. The Scheme also intends to generate income through investments in ﬁxed income securities andusing arbitrage and other derivative Strategies. There can be no assurance that the investment objective of the scheme will berealized.
